finalText:
Build's clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it handed to your code.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That crashed the whole link stage.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as an error. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now defaults to disabled instead of throwing.

Everything else was just deprecation warnings and noise, safe to ignore.
